## Lore

Two dim lamps, three planets, and a graveyard.

At least 33 wrecks of unknown class lie in Abernoth, over 1.1 million tons between them, so others have been here before us. The three largest are 119,531, 111,853 and 111,853 tons. The count comes from the visible contact list, which runs to #44, so more may lie hidden in the cluster.

Found on 15 October 300 by SV-01 Driftmark under Sub-Lieutenant Herbert Whitsell, who was awarded the Wayfinder's Compass, Class III, for the discovery.

On 13 May 311 an unknown ship armed with energy weapons attacked STB-01 [Beacon 001](../../Ships/Beacon-001.md) at Abernoth. Three hits pierced her hull and crippled the stabilisation module, and the Beacon suffered a catastrophic failure and exploded. Her commander, [Octavian Paccius](../../People/Octavian-Paccius.md), was lost with the ship. Lifepods carried 54 of her 250 crew clear, and 196 died. Something still hunts at Abernoth, among the old wrecks. It was the Accord's first ship lost to a hostile hand, and no one knows whose hand it was.
